Name: Tool Geodes (ABANDONED)
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[color=Red][b][size=5]This mod is no longer maintained and may not work in newer game versions.[/size][/b][/color]



[s]Enhance your tools with geodes.

Press G to open the adornments screen.

Universal:
[/s][list]
[*][s]Prismatic Shard - Give three more geode slots.[/s]
[/list][s]

Tools:
[/s][list]
[*][s]Opal [Wcan/Hoe] - Increase the length of your charged tool by two tiles.[/s]
[*][s]Fire opal [Wcan/Hoe] - Increase the width of your charged tool by one tile in each direction.[/s]
[*][s]Ocean stone [Wcan] - Provide infinite water to the watering can.[/s]
[*][s]Tigerseye [Pick/Hoe only] - Provides truesight, seeing inside rocks and dig spots.[/s]
[*][s]Aerinite - Use less stamina.[/s]
[*][s]Fairy stone [WCan/Hoe] - Instant tool charging.[/s]
[*][s]Star shards - Use your tools where you click, even when not right next to you.[/s]
[/list][s]

Weapons
[/s][list]
[*][s]Thunder egg - Provides more damage.[/s]
[*][s]Jamborite - Provides more knockback.[/s]
[*][s]Helvite - Provides more crit chance.[/s]
[*][s]Lunarite - Increases attack speed.[/s]
[*][s]Neptunite - Pierce through rock crab, bug, and fallen mummy armor.[/s]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Tool Geodes
Manifest.Description: Apply geodes to tools for special effects.
Manifest.Author: spacechase0
